rows.event: Walk-in Interview for Data Entry Operator

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on 24th August 2026 for Data Entry Operator and 25th August 2026 for Salespersons and Attendant. Candidates should ensure they attend on the correct date for their applied post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ICSIL?
faq.answer: ICSIL has announced a total of 12 vacancies for the posts of Data Entry Operator, Salespersons, and Attendant through this walk-in recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: For the Data Entry Operator post, the minimum age limit is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 42 years as of the cut-off date.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, all candidates are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 590/- for this recruitment process.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Attendant post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Attendant post is 8th Pass.

faq.question: Q6. What is the daily salary for a Salesperson in ICSIL?
faq.answer: Salespersons will receive a daily salary of Rs. 862/- for their services in ICSIL.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates, along with self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the typing speed requirement for the Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: For the Data Entry Operator position, candidates must possess a typing speed of 30 words per minute in English.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are on a contractual basis, meaning candidates will be hired for a specific period as per the contract terms.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be conducted at the ICSIL office in New Delhi. The exact address and venue details are available in the official notification.
